ModeBoundary: Same registered source_commit; bank captures old correction_enable at actual accept and keeps it for the whole transaction. Due mode applies to a later accepted frame.
Failure: Sticky failed freezes mode and elapsed; original datapath drain/reset unchanged.
ManualModeInterface: No existing mode command: load_arm_parser validates only schema1/op1/24byte ARM; correction_enable only driven by frame_ab_control.
TestsBoundary: Short control test with scaled dwell and a bank-mode capture probe; not full DDR/pixel simulation or physical acceptance.
